arguments.name: Animation Story
arguments.description: Check-tier gate on the blocking (poses in the shot chain) and evidence steps (p014, D81): the film changes its world where the screenplay says it does, not only its figure. Two probes run in order: probe-screenplay.py holds the screenplay contract (ids, frames inside their beats, shots that tile the timeline, state keys, colour keys, registers, current renders) and probe-story.py judges every story point on a bound key (storyPoint on a key or pose within 4 frames), on each `after` key being observable as its recipe reads it, and on the world changing outside the figure. A story point no key binds, a figure that acts over a world that does not change, and an `after` key that never changes each fail the gate.
arguments.subject: animation-story
arguments.guidance: Ground truth by exit code (D81, p014). Two commands run in `media/showcase`: `python3 scripts/animation/probe-screenplay.py v3/screenplay.json` (the contract of v3/screenplay.json) and then `python3 scripts/animation/probe-story.py v3/screenplay.json --frames out/animatic-seq --figure-frames out/animatic-fig-seq` (one line per story point: pass or FAIL and why, read from the keys of v3/keys and v3/poses, the blocking, the xsheet, the light contract and the composed frames of the last animatic render). Each prints its control first and refuses to report if a control does not trip. The frames are those of the last render: at the blocking step they are the previous animatic's, so a prop restaged now is judged on the next render's frames; render (npm run animatic and the figure layer) before the evidence step so that step reads current frames. On FAIL quote each failing story point's line with its id (sp-<beat>.<n>), open the file and field it names, and make the world change where the screenplay says it does: bind the story point to a key (`storyPoint` on the key, within 4 frames of the story point's frame), stage the prop the `after` key names in the blocking, or change the story point's key through the owner-ask path (a proposal on the bible) instead of editing the screenplay. Never edit v3/screenplay.json, a probe or this check to make it pass. Control: a key sheet with the storyPoint binding of sp-1.1 removed is refused with sp-1.1 named.
